basic.name: Desperate Plea
basic.description:
Heal an allied Hero for 140~~0.04~~ and gain Desperation for 4 seconds.

Desperation increases Desperate Plea's Mana cost by 40, and stacks up to 3 times.

Current Mana Cost: 45

basic.name: Inquisition
basic.description:
Channel on an enemy Hero for up to 3 seconds, dealing 50~~0.04~~ damage every 0.5 seconds and Slowing them by 30%. Removes a stack of Desperation.

Shares a cooldown with Clemency.

basic.name: Searing Lash
basic.description:
After 0.5 seconds, smite enemies in a straight line for 82~~0.04~~ damage.

If the first strike hits an enemy Hero, a second strike will occur after a short delay.

Repeatable Quest: Hit Heroes with Searing Lash.
Repeatable Quest: Hit 3 Heroes with Basic Attacks.

Reward: Permanently increase Whitemane's maximum Health by 3 and Mana by 2. Heroes hit with the second strike of Searing Lash count as 2 hits.

heroic.name: Scarlet Aegis
heroic.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300~~0.04~~ and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

heroic.name: Divine Reckoning
heroic.description: After 1 second, consecrate an area for 4 seconds, dealing 50~~0.04~~ damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies inside. 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes is returned as Mana.

trait.name: Zeal
trait.description:
Whitemane's healing Abilities apply Zeal for 8 seconds. Allies with Zeal are healed for 100% of the damage Whitemane deals to Heroes.

Activate to gain 25% Spell Power and lose 15 Armor for 5 seconds. Can be cast while channeling abilities.

activable.name: Clemency
activable.description:
Activate to cast Inquisition on an allied Hero, healing them for up to 329~~0.04~~ over 3 seconds while Channeling. Removes a stack of Desperation

Shares a cooldown with Inquisition.

activable.name: Intercession
activable.description: Activate to make an ally Unstoppable for 1 second.

activable.name: Guiding Light
activable.description:
Activate to cast a permanent Zeal on an allied Hero that costs no Mana and doesn't grant Desperation. Only one can be active at a time and has global cast range.

Increases the Spell Power bonus provided by Whitemane's trait by 15%.

activable.name: Purge the Wicked
activable.description: Activate to blast an enemy Hero with holy fire, reducing their Armor by 25 and dealing 300~~0.04~~ damage over 4 seconds.

level1.name: Pity the Frail
level1.description: For every Hero hit with Searing Lash, lower the cooldown of Inquisition by 1 seconds. Allies below 30% Health receive 25% more healing from Whitemane.

level1.name: Righteous Flame
level1.description: Searing Lash deals 25% more damage to enemies. If the second strike hits an enemy Hero, they take an additional 25% damage and Whitemane gains 40% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

level1.name: Inquisitor's Prayer
level1.description: Searing Lash restores 25 Mana for each Hero it hits, and Zeal lasts 2 additional seconds.

level4.name: Unwavering Faith
level4.description: Increase Whitemane's Basic Attack range by 1.1. Whitemane gains 20% increased Basic Attack damage for each active Zeal buff.

level4.name: Martyrdom
level4.description: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

level4.name: Indulgence
level4.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Increase this by an additional 5% for each active Zeal.

level7.name: Zealous Spirit
level7.description: Upon reaching 2 stacks of Desperation, Whitemane gains Zeal.

level7.name: Saintly Greatstaff
level7.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Searing Lash are marked for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks against them deal an additional 55~~0.04~~ Spell damage and remove the mark.

level7.name: Intercession
level7.description: Activate to make an ally Unstoppable for 1 second.

level13.description: Inquisition reduces all damage the target deals by 50%.

level13.name: Lashing Out
level13.description: If Searing Lash's second strike hits an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown to 1 second.

level13.name: Scarlet Wrath
level13.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes increase the duration of all active Zeals by 0.75 seconds, restore 1% Mana to all Zeal targets, and lower the cooldown of Zeals activation by 4 seconds.

level16.name: Radiance
level16.description: Reaching 3 stacks of Desperation heals for 190~~0.04~~ and reapplies Zeal to allies with Zeal.

level16.name: Shared Punishment
level16.description: Upon casting, Inquisition can chain to an additional enemy Hero near its target, dealing 50~~0.04~~ damage every 0.5 seconds. Affected enemies lose 10 Armor.

level16.name: Harsh Discipline
level16.description:
Hitting a Hero with Searing Lash while they are being targeted by Inquisition Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

Passive: Reduce Inquisition's cooldown by 2 seconds.

level20.name: Scarlet Crusade
level20.description: Scarlet Aegis heals for 50% more and makes affected allies Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

level20.name: Judgment Day
level20.description: Divine Reckoning deals 50% more damage and pulls enemies to its center the first time it hits them.
